item.tib: sdom pa gsum gyi gso sbyong phyir bcos kyi rim pa shel dkar phreng mdzes
item.coloph: zhes sdom gsum phyir bcos kyi tshul 'di yang 'dul 'dzin gong ma rnams kyi phyag len la gzhir byas shing snyigs dus kyi ngur smrig 'dzin pa chen po rgyal dbang shar rdza pa'i phyag len dang gsung rgyun las ji ltar byung ba bzhin rang bzos ma bslad par khod spungs dbra zhig stong (ston) pas nye bar sbyar bas sdom gsum rnam par dag pa'i rgyur gyur cig/
